verifiedSurfaceSummary: Runtime qualification requires the current corporate/native public client contract, active default API filters, every declared page and exact closing payload reconciliation. A native declared total of zero can establish fresh source absence; positive native cards retain full raw observations but remain incomplete when descriptions are line-clamped without a public full-criteria reveal or native work countries are missing. Native posting IDs, original plain React text and CMS timestamps are preserved without inventing formal requisitions or job publication dates. Whole client asset hashes remain provenance; unrelated private application copy is not an inventory gate.
